subject: general
question: In May 2021, the Chief Minister of _______ announced the Mukhyamantri Sishu Sewa Achoni scheme, which will provide relief to children who have lost their parents due to Covid-19.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Assam government unveiled the "**Mukhyamantri Sishu Sewa Achoni Scheme**" on May 29, 2021, as a new program for kids whose parents passed away from COVID-19.
 
• This **announcement was made by Chief Minister Hemant Biswa Sarma.**
 
• The child's guardian within the extended family would get a monthly stipend of Rs. 3,500.
 
• The state government would contribute the remaining Rs. 3,500, with Rs. 2000 coming from the central government.
 
• State government's child care facilities will house children under 10 who are without a guardian or caregiver.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **state government of Odisha** has also launched a scheme called the **"Ashirbad"** scheme to provide financial assistance to children who lost their parents due to Covid-19.
 
• The **state government of Gujarat** has announced a scheme called the **"Bal Seva Yojana"** to provide financial assistance and care to children who lost their parents due to Covid-19.
 
• The **state government of Bihar** has announced a scheme called the **"Bihar Baal Sahayata Yojana"** to provide financial assistance and care to children who lost their parents due to Covid-19.
